name: SOC-A03-Injection
description: OWASP A03:2021 — Detect and respond to SQL/Command/XSS Injection from Suricata IDS alerts enriched by SOC ML Engine with CVE/CWE data.

parameters.name: call
parameters.value: INJECTION DETECTED: $exec.signature | SRC: $exec.src_ip -> $exec.dest_ip | CVE: $exec.cve | CWE: $exec.cwe | Severity: $exec.severity

parameters.name: call
parameters.value:
PATCH REQUIRED:
Vulnerability: $exec.owasp_name ($exec.owasp_id)
Affected CVE: $exec.cve
CWE Classification: $exec.cwe
NIST Controls: $exec.nist_iso_controls
MITRE Mitigation: $exec.mitre_mitigation
Steps: $exec.patch_steps

parameters.name: info
parameters.value: Receives injection alerts from SOC ML Engine /ingest
